Neues aus der Szene: Cevin Fisher, celebrated New Jersey house DJ and producer, dies aged 63. A fixture of the US house scene for four decades, Fisher was behind anthems including ‘The Freaks Come Out’ and ‘(You Got Me) Burnin’ Up’ (DJ Mag.) Influential New Jersey house DJ and producer Cevin Fisher has died aged 63. Across more than four decades, Fisher helped shape house music (Mixmag.) New book, How Music Can Save The World, explores how music can drive social change. Written by author and speaker Shain Shapiro, the book tells stories of music’s power from across the world (DJ Mag.) “Good practice” guide launched for new and independent music promoters. The guide, which has been created by AFEM, lays out ethical approaches to ticketing, marketing, event insurance and more (Mixmag.)
